summaryEvents.text: The plug orientation matches the socket. Calibration is complete; the agent approaches while checking clearance and force.
The plug is close to the socket. The agent corrects a lateral offset before surface contact.
The tip contacts the socket face with the fingers clear. The opening remains visible, so entry is not yet confirmed.
A gap remains at the opening. The agent eases pressure and corrects sideways after an adjustment increased load without useful movement.
Both wrist views confirm entry. The agent proceeds with alignment and insertion while checking all three views.
The plug has advanced and remains engaged. The agent reduces residual lateral and bending load.
Alignment adjustments are complete and bending has decreased. The agent prepares the withdrawal, release and cable-regrasp sequence.
